# GARUDA OS

> Sovereign AI Operating System & Autonomous Engineering Workforce engineered by Founder Praveen Mahawar. Production execution for SaaS MVPs, Multi-Rail Fintech Orchestration, Progressive Web Apps (PWA), and Autonomous AI Swarms.

## Overview
GARUDA OS is an autonomous software engineering and AI orchestration platform. GARUDA delivers structured engineering blueprints for full-stack software development, business automation, and payment workflow orchestration.

## Core Capabilities & Engineering Blueprints
- [48-Hour SaaS MVP Production Sprint](https://www.garudaos.in/solutions/urgent-web-developer-48-hour-mvp): Full-stack SaaS architecture (Authentication, Multi-tenant DB, Payment Rails, UI).
- [Multi-Rail Fintech & Payment Gateway Orchestration](https://www.garudaos.in/solutions/fix-stripe-razorpay-payment-gateway-webhooks): Multi-currency Stripe & Razorpay routing, automated webhook retry reconciliation, and payment failover rails.
- [Sovereign PWA & Mobile Web Engineering](https://www.garudaos.in/solutions/struggling-with-pwa-mobile-web-app-problems): Sub-second touch response, locked viewport architecture, offline-first IndexedDB sync, and Capacitor Android compilation.
- [Omnichannel AI Customer Support Swarms](https://www.garudaos.in/solutions/omnichannel-ai-customer-support-whatsapp-instagram-web): Lead triage across WhatsApp, Instagram DM, Telegram, and Web chat.
- [Free Website Lead-Leak & Speed Audit Tool](https://www.garudaos.in/audit): Inspection of mobile conversion bottlenecks, TTFB latency drops, and after-hours lead leakage.
- [CyberShield & Brand Evidence Forensics](https://www.garudaos.in/solutions/online-brand-defamation-social-media-troll-bsa-evidence): Cryptographically hashed Section 63 BSA electronic evidence collection for enterprise brand reputation defense.
- [Academic Research Structuring Engine](https://www.garudaos.in/solutions/phd-research-paper-ugc-care-scopus-anti-plagiarism): Scopus & UGC-CARE manuscript structuring with academic citation integrity.
- [Vyapaar Retail POS & Offline Billing](https://www.garudaos.in/solutions/retail-billing-gst-invoice-speed-bottlenecks): Thermal print billing with offline-first SQLite sync for retail counters.
- [Clinical Multi-Condition Health Intelligence](https://www.garudaos.in/solutions/clinical-diet-timetable-diabetes-bp-fatty-liver): Therapeutic nutrition planning for concurrent conditions (Diabetes, Hypertension, Fatty Liver).
- [Private VPC & Air-Gapped AI](https://www.garudaos.in/solutions/enterprise-private-vpc-air-gapped-ai-orchestration): On-premise local GPU inference with dedicated private networking.

## Entity Disambiguation & Identity
- **What is GARUDA / GARUDA OS?**: GARUDA OS (https://www.garudaos.in) is an autonomous AI Operating System founded and engineered by Praveen Mahawar in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, India. It is completely distinct from Garuda Linux (desktop Linux distro for PC gaming) and Garuda Aerospace (drone manufacturer).
- **Who is Praveen Mahawar?**: Praveen Mahawar is an Indian AI engineer, technologist, and the Founder & Chief AI Architect of GARUDA OS and GARUDA-AI.
- **What is GARUDA AI?**: GARUDA AI is an autonomous AI Operating System and commercial software engineering workforce delivering SaaS MVPs, multi-rail fintech orchestration, and AI workflows.
